title: How two Chinese nationals and their sons cheated US Medicare and Medicaid of $55 million
summary_full: Two Chinese nationals and their sons have been indicted in the US over an alleged $55 million Medicare and Medicaid fraud scheme. Prosecutors claim the Queens-based family billed government health programmes for unnecessary medicines, including pain patches, and paid beneficiaries cash and supermarket gift cards to fill prescriptions. The family allegedly used shell companies and fake pharmacy ownership records to conceal the money, which was spent on properties, investments, cryptocurrency and luxury vehicles.
